title: Condensation
learningObjective: Students will describe how clouds form through condensation

procedure.instruction: Watch the video 'How Clouds Are Made' to learn about condensation.
scaffoldingSupports: Pause to discuss: Water vapor goes up into the sky
Pause to discuss: When vapor cools, it forms tiny water droplets
Point out: Lots of droplets together make a cloud

procedure.instruction: Click to cool down water vapor and watch droplets form.
scaffoldingSupports: Explain: High in the sky it gets cold
Explain: Cold vapor turns back into tiny water droplets

procedure.instruction: Label the diagram: Show where water vapor is, where it cools, and where the cloud forms.
scaffoldingSupports: Provide word bank: water vapor, cooling, cloud, droplets

procedure.instruction: Learn vocabulary: condensation, water droplets, clouds, cooling.
scaffoldingSupports: Define condensation: When water vapor (gas) turns into liquid droplets
Connect to real life: Foggy mirror after shower

multimediaResources.caption: Learn how water vapor condenses to form clouds
multimediaResources.accessibilityDescription: Video showing water vapor rising into the atmosphere, cooling, and forming clouds

multimediaResources.caption: Click to cool water vapor and see droplets form
multimediaResources.accessibilityDescription: Interactive showing temperature control and cloud formation

exitTicket.questionText: What do you need to make a cloud? Check all that apply.
exitTicket.explanation: Clouds form when water vapor rises up into the sky, cools down, and turns into tiny water droplets. Millions of droplets together make a cloud!
